title: Distinguish P104 physical and backward-chart dual contracts
head: 249c4034da118da35f1e6009744b81461172bc61
body:
The P104 dual results in PR2479/2522 and PR2497 certify different physical boundary operators. This focused contract map gives an exact shared-row witness: with `C[2,0]=1/2`, physical input `Y2=delta_0` produces `X0[0]=0` in the backward-chart dual and `(-1+i)/64` in the ordinary physical inverse-transpose. Canonical and intrinsic versions are computed separately; their full columns differ. The predecessor statements are already correctly scoped, so this is a navigation/interface result rather than a defect report.

The proof states the precise missing conversion. For `F=Gamma_f S Gamma_i^(-1)` and backward-chart `R=Gamma_i S^(-T) Gamma_f^(-1)`, the wrappers `A=Gamma_f^(-T) Gamma_i^(-1)` and `B=Gamma_f Gamma_i^T` satisfy `A R B=F^(-T)`. Their native implementation and full cost are not supplied. PR2522's allocation-free result continues to apply to its exact original-core physical operator; it is not silently transferred to the corrected word. No new dual construction, complete supplier, precision result, all-size admission or kappa is claimed.

The new `research/p104-dual-boundary-contracts/` package retains the three exact source proof texts, source SHA256/Git blobs, a written derivation, an exact receipt and registered replay. It reconstructs all 14,400 physical root pairings, binds the two endpoint charts/adapters, checks both 512-entry witness columns with separate arithmetic implementations, corroborates the intrinsic zero by a closed four-term calculation, and verifies both-sided wrapping identities for the relevant Clifford blocks. Eight failure controls and five Git-free/export/source-integrity test groups pass. It does not rerun or recertify full predecessor words or their attributed invoices.

Validation: native CPython 3.12.7 registered optimized replay and all 5 export groups pass; native CPython 3.14.5 optimized replay and the selected baseline-binding check pass. Reproduce with `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-boundary-contracts`. Separate OpenAI Codex review found no material issue in the algebra, source binding, or stated limits; its optimized 3.12.7 replay and five export groups passed; no human, formal-kernel or hosted-CI pass is claimed.
